requires.n: Cards Allowing a Creature to Tap for Free

requires.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Academy Manufactor, or previously used to create a copy

643-1486-4231-5400--108--119.description:
Use the permanent that allows you to tap creatures for free to tap two untapped creatures you control.
Magda triggers twice due to Maskwood Nexus, creating six Treasure tokens, six Food tokens, and six three Clue tokens.
Activate Magda by sacrificing five Treasures, searching your library for Synth Infiltrator. If this is a clone effect, have it copy Academy Manufactor.
Use the permanent that allows you to tap creatures for free to tap an untapped creature you control.
Magda triggers due to Maskwood Nexus, creating at least six Treasure tokens, at least three Food tokens, and at least three Clue tokens.
Activate Magda by sacrificing five Treasures, searching your library for any creature and putting it onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 4.
Once you have sufficient excess Treasure tokens, you may activate Magda additional times to search your library for noncreature artifacts and put them onto the battlefield.

2023-4289-4460-4770.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
Aragorn triggers, creating a 1/1 Human Soldier creature token.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Human Soldier token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-3249-5457-6006--52.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-3249-5457-6006--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Enduring Vitality by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Enduring Vitality by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the creature castable for one mana from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature spell from your graveyard by paying it mana cost.
When you cast that creature or when it enters, Selvala triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature token, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

3899-7084-7422.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Garrison Excavator triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.

833-1362-3827-5607.notablePrerequisites: Soul of Windgrace and Klauth can attack without taking damage.
833-1362-3827-5607.description:
Declare Klauth and Soul of Windgrace as attackers.
When they attack, Klauth and Soul of Windgrace trigger.
Resolve the Klauth trigger, adding at least nine mana that you will not lose this turn as steps and phases end.
Resolve the Soul of Windgrace trigger, returning Oboro, Palace in the Clouds from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Activate the last ability of Oboro, Palace in the Clouds by paying {1}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
In your next main phase, cast Waves of Aggression from your graveyard for its retrace cost by paying {3}{R/W}{R/W} and discarding Oboro, Palace in the Clouds, causing you to untap all creatures that attacked this turn, and to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Repeat.

275-1976-5078.description:
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} due to Etherium Sculptor.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Transplant Theorist triggers.
Holding priority, activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Resolve the Transplant Theorist trigger, causing you to draw Sensei's Divining Top from your library, and then discard a card other than Sensei's Divining Top.
Repeat

2034-5003-7899.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Fili the Pathfinder, adding {C}{C}.
When Fili the Pathfinder dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Fili the Pathfinder from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Fili the Pathfinder enters, it triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.
2034-5003-7899.notes: You can sacrifice any nontoken Dwarf you control in place of Fili.

215-1879-3151.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five Elves.
215-1879-3151.description:
Activate Elvish Archdruid by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Elvish Archdruid from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Elvish Archdruid by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

2033-7060-7686.notablePrerequisites: You control four or more Squirrels.
2033-7060-7686.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate four Squirrels by tapping them, adding {G}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat
2033-7060-7686.notes: You'll create double as many Squirrels each loop. All Squirrels beyond the first four will be untapped and can be used to add additional mana.

3532-5078-5645-7742.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
3532-5078-5645-7742.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Machinesmith Automaton triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Machinesmith Automaton.
Repeat.

465-3742-4251-4460-5929.description:
Declare Phantom Steed and Godo as attackers, triggering each of their second abilities.
Resolve the Godo trigger, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Phantom Steed trigger, creating a token copy of Wormfang Drake.
When the token Wormfang Drake enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Godo.
At the end of your combat phase, Phantom Steed triggers, causing you to sacrifice the Wormfang Drake token.
When the token Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Godo from exile to the battlefield.
When Godo enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, allowing you to search your library for an Equipment card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

6191-7286.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
6191-7286.description:
Gain life.
South Wind Avatar triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life.
Bloodthirsty Conqueror triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

2034-2653-5478-7090.description:
Activate Ba Sing Se's second ability by paying {2}{G} and tapping it, earthbending itself.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Ba Sing Se, adding {C}{C}.
When Ba Sing Se dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Spelunking.
When Ba Sing Se enters, Nissa triggers, adding {G}.
Repeat.

304-1978-3053.easyPrerequisites: There are at least three basic land types among lands you control
304-1978-3053.description:
Animate Prismatic Geoscope using Tough Cookie.
Activate Prismatic Geoscope by tapping it, adding at least three mana of any color
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Prismatic Geoscope.
Repeat from step 2.

454-3401-5803.manaNeeded: {11}{U}{U} minus {1} for each other artifact you control
454-3401-5803.notablePrerequisites:
Kitsa has power 2 or greater and does not have summoning sickness.
Artifacts you control can tap to produce at least {2}.
454-3401-5803.description:
Cast Phyrexian Scriptures
When Phyrexian Scriptures enters, its first chapter ability triggers, causing Kitsa to become an artifact.
Cast Blinkmoth Infusion by paying {12}{U}{U}, minus {1} for each artifact you control.
Kitsa's prowess ability triggers, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Holding priority, activate any number of mana-producing artifacts you control, adding at least {2}.
Activate Kitsa's second ability by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Blinkmoth Infusion.
Resolve the copy of Blinkmoth Infusion, untapping all artifacts you control.
Repeat from step 5.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with a +1/+1 counter on it and has lifelink

1495-4613-5877.description:
Activate Vampire Scrivener by using Triskelion's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain 1 life due to its lifelink.
Vampire Scrivener triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

1170-2499-3389-4826-5954.description:
Cast Flickering Ward by paying {W}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When Overlord of the Hauntwoods enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens, which enter untapped due to Archelos.
Resolve the Flickering Ward spell.
Activate the two Everywhere tokens by tapping them, adding {W}{W}.
Activate Flickering Ward by paying {W}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

2034-2178-4147-4215.easyPrerequisites: Thornbite Staff attached to Hua Tuo.
2034-2178-4147-4215.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional nontoken green creature.
Hua Tuo does not have summoning sickness.
2034-2178-4147-4215.description:
During your precombat main phase, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the additional nontoken green creature, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Verdant Succession and Hua Tuo trigger.
Holding priority, activate Hua Tuo by tapping it, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Hua Tuo trigger from step 2, untapping it.
Resolve the Verdant Succession trigger, searching your library for the sacrificed creature and putting it onto the battlefield.
Repeat.

2146-2908-3682-5542.description:
Cast Mox Amber by paying {0}.
Activate Mox Amber by tapping it, adding one mana.
Cast Dream Stalker by paying one mana.
When Dream Stalker enters, it triggers twice due to Delney, returning Mox Amber and Dream Stalker from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

307-3542-4623.notablePrerequisites:
Mist-Syndicate Naga and Palinchron do not have summoning sickness.
An opponent cannot block Mist-Syndicate Naga or Palinchron.
You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
307-3542-4623.description:
Declare Palinchron and Mist-Syndicate Naga as attackers.
When they aren't blocked, activate up to seven lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
Activate Thousand-Faced Shadow's ninjutsu ability by paying {2}{U}{U} and returning Mist-Syndicate Naga from the battlefield to your hand, putting Thousand-Faced Shadow onto the battlefield from your hand tapped and attacking.
When Thousand-Faced Shadow enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a token copy of Palinchron that is tapped and attacking.
When the Palinchron token enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands.
Activate Mist-Syndicate Naga's ninjutsu ability by paying {2}{U} and returning Thousand-Faced Shadow from the battlefield to your hand, putting Mist-Syndicate Naga onto the battlefield from your hand tapped and attacking.
Repeat from step 2.
Deal combat damage using the Palinchron tokens, dealing infinite combat damage to the defending opponent.
If you control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {5}{U}{U}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana.

380-703-1308.description:
Cast Astral Dragon by paying {6}{U}{U}.
Astral Dragon enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Miirym.
Resolve the Astral Dragon trigger, creating four token copies of Anointed Procession that are 3/3 Dragons in addition to their other types.
Resolve the Miirym trigger, creating a total of 32 Astral Dragon tokens.
The Astral Dragon tokens enter the battlefield, creating an extremely large number of Anointed Procession tokens that are 3/3 Dragons in addition to their other types.

2034-2249-5086.notablePrerequisites: Triskelavus has at least two +1/+1 counters on it.
2034-2249-5086.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating a 1/1 Triskelavite artifact creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Triskelavite, adding {C}{C}.
When the Triskelavite dies, Death's Presence triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Triskelavus.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may instead sacrifice the Triskelavite using its own ability to deal infinite damage to any target(s).

768-1061-5261.notablePrerequisites:
Timestream Navigator does not have summoning sickness.
You have the city's blessing.
768-1061-5261.description:
Activate Timestream Navigator by paying {2}{U}{U}, tapping it and putting it on the bottom of your library, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Eladamri's Call without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Eladamri's Call, searching your library for Timestream Navigator and putting it into your hand.
Cast TImestream Navigator by paying {1}{U}.
Repeat each turn.

813-1518-1987-4792.notablePrerequisites: Will Kenrith has at least two loyalty counters.
813-1518-1987-4792.description:
Activate Will Kenrith's -2 ability targeting yourself, reducing the cost of your instant, sorcery, and planeswalker spells by {2} until end of turn and drawing you 2 cards.
Activate Paradise Plume by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Paradise Plume and Scholar of the Ages, blinking them as well as triggering Paradise Plume to gain you 1 life.
When Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
When Paradise Plume enters the battlefield, choose "blue".
Repeat.
